# ZD Pigments

> Dry pigments and binders for painters. A colour shop placed in Norwich, Norfolk, England, selling artists' dry pigment by weight, the binders that turn it into paint, and the tools to grind it. Supply is by enquiry; the shop posts within the United Kingdom.

- Home: https://zdpigments.com/ — the swatch wall, what the shop sells, how an order runs, questions painters ask
- Earth pigments: https://zdpigments.com/earth-pigments.html — the earth and mineral colours one by one, plus the few synthetics
- Binders and mediums: https://zdpigments.com/binders-and-mediums.html — gum arabic, linseed and walnut oil, egg tempera, size, stand oil
- Grinding and mulling: https://zdpigments.com/grinding-and-mulling.html — pigment to paint on a slab, stage by stage
- Ask for a swatch card: https://zdpigments.com/ask-for-a-swatch-card.html — the enquiry form
- Privacy: https://zdpigments.com/privacy.html
- Terms: https://zdpigments.com/terms.html

Not offered: pigment for industrial, cosmetic, food or tattoo use; safety classification or handling advice; solvents; identification of pigment in existing paintings.
